decision: Required to start the race from the pit lane.
event_name: Date 18 July 2021 Time 12:45 2021 BRITISH GRAND PRIX 15 - 18 July 2021 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Technical Delegate (document 45), have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: The rear wing assembly has been changed and changes have also been made to the setup of the suspension and to the cooling of the front brakes.
offence: Breach of Article 34.6 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
penalty: Required to start the race from the pit lane.
reason: The changed rear wing is different from the one used during sprint qualifying, changes have also been made to the setup of the suspension and cooling of the front brakes. The rear wing was replaced, changes to the suspension setup and cooling of the front brakes were made with the approval of the FIA Technical Delegate as per Article 34.2 As the rear wing is different and changes have been made to the to the suspension setup and front brake cooling whilst the car was in parc ferme, the competitor is required to start the race from the pit lane per Article 34.6 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
rules_referenced: Article 34.6 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
title: Offence Car 11 Rear Wing And Parc Ferme Changes
